PARAMS = {
    "Win":   (3.0, 1.0, 10.0),   # differential pair width (um), L=0.15
    "Wtail": (3.0, 1.0, 10.0),   # clocked tail width
    "Wln":   (1.5, 0.5, 5.0),    # latch NMOS width
    "Wlp":   (1.5, 0.5, 5.0),    # latch PMOS width
    "Wrst":  (0.6, 0.42, 2.0),   # reset PMOS width
    "Winv":  (1.0, 0.42, 4.0),   # output inverter NMOS width (PMOS = 2x)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    L = 0.15
    VDD = 1.8
    dv = spec.get("dv", 0.002)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 10e-15)
    Win, Wt, Wln, Wlp, Wr, Wi = p["Win"], p["Wtail"], p["Wln"], p["Wlp"], p["Wrst"], p["Winv"]

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn clk outp outn vdd vss")
    # clocked tail
    n.M("M0", "tail", "clk", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wt, L)
    # differential pair: vinp -> node P, vinn -> node Q
    n.M("M1", "P", "vinp", "tail", "vss", "nfet", Win, L)
    n.M("M2", "Q", "vinn", "tail", "vss", "nfet", Win, L)
    # cross-coupled latch: xa above P (falls first when vinp>vinn)
    n.M("M3", "xa", "xb", "P", "vss", "nfet", Wln, L)
    n.M("M4", "xb", "xa", "Q", "vss", "nfet", Wln, L)
    n.M("M5", "xa", "xb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wlp, L)
    n.M("M6", "xb", "xa", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wlp, L)
    # reset switches (clk low -> precharge to VDD)
    n.M("M7", "P", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wr, L)
    n.M("M8", "Q", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wr, L)
    n.M("M9", "xa", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wr, L)
    n.M("M10", "xb", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wr, L)
    # output inverters: xa low -> outp high
    n.M("M11", "outp", "xa", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wi, L)
    n.M("M12", "outp", "xa", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2 * Wi, L)
    n.M("M13", "outn", "xb", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wi, L)
    n.M("M14", "outn", "xb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2 * Wi, L)

    # ---- first-order predictions ----
    oin = lut.op("n", Win, L, 0.65, 0.6)
    ot = lut.op("n", Wt, L, 1.8, 0.15)
    itail = min(2 * oin["Id"], ot["Id"]) if ot["Id"] > 0 else 2 * oin["Id"]
    on = lut.op("n", Wln, L, 0.9, 0.9)
    op_ = lut.op("p", Wlp, L, 0.9, 0.9)
    oi_n = lut.op("n", Wi, L, 0.9, 0.9)
    oi_p = lut.op("p", 2 * Wi, L, 0.9, 0.9)
    cgu = 1.2e-15  # F/um, gate + junction estimate at L=0.15
    cP = (0.5 * Win + 0.5 * Wln + 0.5 * Wr) * cgu
    cX = (0.6 * Wln + 0.6 * Wlp + 0.5 * Wr) * cgu + on["cgg"] + op_["cgg"] + oi_n["cgg"] + oi_p["cgg"]
    gml = on["gm"] + op_["gm"]
    t_int = (2 * cP * 0.6 + 2 * cX * 0.5) / max(itail, 1e-6)
    gm_in = oin["gm"]
    av = max(gm_in * t_int / max(cX, 1e-16), 1.0)
    tau = cX / max(gml, 1e-6)
    t_reg = tau * math.log(max(VDD / (av * dv), 2.0))
    t_inv = 0.69 * (cl + 2e-15) * 1.0 / max(oi_p["gm"], 1e-6) * 2
    delay = t_int + t_reg + t_inv
    energy = (2 * cP * VDD + 1.5 * cX * VDD + (cl + 2 * Wi * cgu) * VDD + 0.5 * Wt * cgu * VDD) * VDD
    return n, {"correct": 1, "delay": delay, "energy": energy}
